notes.title: My next game: Cursemark
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, I'm excited to announce my next game, [b]Cursemark[/b]. It's an action-exploration roguelike, with a huge hand crafted world, tons of cool equipment, and many opportunities to create crazy builds. I can't wait to go on this journey with you all, and make the game everything it can be. Please consider [b]wishlisting[/b] the game. Thanks!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3219180/Cursemark

notes.title: Frauki is free!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, I just updated the game to be free. If you were curious about it but didn't want to pay, have fun! It's my first effort at a game, so it's a bit rough around the edges. But I think if you're into dark souls-like combat and some exploration you might enjoy it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40032504/b241168be21052dd561885c50e2749f0a4839d03.png[/img]


I also just brought my second game, Into the Necrovale, out of Early Access. Feel free to check that out as well.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1717090/Into_the_Necrovale/

Thanks,
CLYDE

notes.title: Into the Necrovale
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40032504/12a597e7cdec7b6e747bcc626ccc7e1dea8a2273.png[/img]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1717090/Into_the_Necrovale/]Into the Necrovale on Steam[/url]

For my next game, I wanted to make something inspired by the thrill of collecting powerful items, and crafting a build that can wreck havoc on your enemies. You play as a criminal, banished into the Necrovale, where a thousand generations of lowlifes, degenerates, and outcasts have been sent. 

[previewyoutube=NutYOfgY3lk;full][/previewyoutube]

In this game, I designed hundreds of unique items that interact in interesting ways. Half the fun is experimenting with the items, and seeing what works, and what doesn't. You might just find something completely new, that I never expected to work. 

Thanks for reading this, and I hope you'll give the game a chance. Take care.
